TITLE: Art Deco Hardwood Yahtzee Box - Handmade Dice Set - Custom Engraving, Epoxy Dice Upgrade
DESCRIPTION:
This vintage-inspired, art deco Yahtzee set is perfect for travel, game night, the brewery, or anywhere you want to play. Each hardwood box is handmade by me in Wisconsin, USA.

Included in each set:
- Hardwood box with metal hinges and clasp
- Laminated art deco score card (designed and made by me)
- Dry erase marker
- 5 dice (standard mass-produced, or upgrade to beautiful handmade epoxy resin dice, also made by me)
- Natural finish with hand-rubbed danish oil

Size:
Roughly 6.7" × 5.7" × 1.5" (170mm × 150mm × 40mm), although with any handmade product there are slight variations.

Upgrades:
I'm happy to personalize a box for you with text or images for an upcharge. Also keep in mind this will take a bit longer.

If you go for some of my handmade dice, I'll choose some for you. If you mention a particular color scheme you're looking for, I'll do my very best to do that for you. Because each dice set is completely unique, unfortunately I can't guarantee any particular style. But please send me a message if you have something specific in mind and I'm happy to work with you to get the perfect set.

Everything except the marker and hinges is handmade by me with no AI support. Each box is one-of-a-kind and may arrive with small design variations and imperfections. That's what makes it real! 

Thank you SO much for taking a look. I worked really hard on these and went through over a hundred iterations before getting something I felt proud to sell. If you have any comments, questions, or concerns please send me a message and I'll get back to you ASAP.

TITLE: VAMPYR Handmade Resin TTRPG Dice Set – D&D, Pathfinder
DESCRIPTION:
VAMPYR 8-Piece Dice Set
Tabletop Gaming Dice for Dungeons & Dragons (D&D), Pathfinder, Call of Cthulhu, Shadowrun, and more

VAMPYR leans into the dark side... think bats in the night, fog on old stone, and that eerie feeling when something’s watching you from the shadows. Comes with blood red numbers which still look wet...

Some people also think this looks like cookies and cream ice cream, or a cow. Whatever floats your boat 😂 

This set comes with the full lineup:
D4, D6, D8, D10, D12, D20, D100 (percentile die), and a D2 coin.
The D2 can pull double duty as a status effect marker, an enemy token, or just a fun coin flip.

I make these by hand in my shop in Madison, WI. Every set is one-of-a-kind. I design and print my own masters and pour my own silicone molds before creating the dice sets. After pouring the epoxy resin and curing it under pressure, I then sand, polish, and paint each die by hand, so no two ever come out exactly the same.

Perfect for your in-person or digital campaigns, or as a cool gift for someone who appreciates handmade dice.

Thanks for checking out my work!
